objective: Screen two Defense First remainder candidates (DF01 published SPY fallback, DF02 SHY fallback) plus the DF00 no-change reference for whether redirecting S3's already-idle remainder into a published Defense First rotation (Carlson 2025) raises the design-window (2016-2023) Sharpe and cuts the drawdown versus plain SHY, beyond a momentum-free diversification control (EW) and 40 random-ranking placebos per candidate (RR-k), without breaking the frozen anchor-window return bar.

holdout_2026: already spent on the live S3 book; no holdout claim made here

ew_static_basket.description: One shared control (EW): static 25/25/25/25 TLT/GLD/DBC/UUP basket, rebalanced monthly, no momentum ranking, no cash-hurdle screen, no fallback substitution -- isolates diversification into the same four defensive assets from the momentum-ranking mechanism. Valid from 2016-05-02 (no warmup needed). Not counted as a candidate; both DF01 and DF02 are compared against this same single EW series.

rr_k_random_ranking.description: 40 placebos per candidate (RR01-1..RR01-40 for DF01; RR02-1..RR02-40 for DF02): each month, the same cash-hurdle screen (asset momentum score vs BIL momentum score) and the same 40/30/20/10 weights and the same fallback asset (SPY for RR01-*, SHY for RR02-*) are applied exactly as in the real candidate, but the rank-to-asset assignment is a fresh seeded random permutation of the four defensive assets each month (seed = placebo index, advanced monthly across the design window's decision dates in date order) instead of a momentum-based rank -- isolates whether the momentum ranking itself (not the screen, weights, or fallback) carries information. Design window only, same warmup as the real candidate (defaults to DF00 before 2017-02-03).

fixed_simulation_budget.description: 2 new candidate simulations (DF01, DF02) + 1 EW control + 80 RR-k placebos (40 seeds x 2 candidates) = 83 simulations, fixed. DF00 requires no new simulation: its design-window numbers are reused from reports/paper/renewal/2026-09-23-s3-stress-2016-2023.json and its anchor-window numbers from the authorized 2026-09-23 S1-S3 renewal record.

design_window: (b) max drawdown no worse than DF00's
(c) Sharpe beats >= 36 of its 40 RR-k placebos
anchor_window_do_no_harm: (e) at both 10 and 20 bp: CAGR >= 50% and max drawdown >= -35% (frozen gate G1)
adoption_rule.multiple_comparisons: 2 candidates (DF01, DF02); report both regardless of outcome
